slides.texte_overlay:
Easy meals every man
should know how to cook
A proper omelette. Eggs, butter, salt, a little cheese. Ready in five minutes, perfect for breakfast, lunch or a late dinner when you're tired.
A simple tomato pasta. Garlic, olive oil, a tin of tomatoes, basil. Cheap, quick and good enough to cook for a date or for friends.
A roast chicken with vegetables. Put everything in one tray and let the oven do the work. It feeds four people and leftovers make great lunches.
A stir fry. Any vegetables, a protein, soy sauce, rice. Fast, healthy and a great way to use whatever is left in the fridge.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Learning the story behind dishes makes cooking even more fun.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Learning the story behind dishes makes cooking even more fun.

slides.texte_overlay: A big pot of chilli. Beans, meat or not, spices, tomatoes. Cook once, eat three times. Perfect for busy weeks and cold evenings.
A good steak. Hot pan, salt, rest it before cutting. Knowing how to cook a steak properly is a small skill that always impresses.
